images.title: Views of a C made of cubes
images.purpose: Show a stack of 8 identical cubes shaped like a C and its three views.
images.composition: The cube stack on the left, large; its three views in a column on the right.
images.exact_structure: Left: 8 identical cubes glued face to face into a letter C, drawn in simple isometric, cubes filled teal #0072B2 with thin dark outlines: a row of 3 cubes on top, 1 cube under the left end, 1 more cube under that, and a row of 3 cubes at the bottom, so 4 cubes tall, 3 cubes wide and 1 cube deep (3 + 1 + 1 + 3 = 8). Right, three small flat views made of equal squares with amber #E69F00 outlines, top to bottom: the front view, a C of 8 squares labelled 'front'; the top view, a row of 3 squares labelled 'top'; the side view, a column of 4 squares labelled 'side'.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each view shows one square for every column of cubes you see in that direction.
images.description: Show a stack of 8 identical cubes shaped like a C and its three views.
images.context: One clean concept image for T12.C3.

image_decisions.why: Reading views of stacks is the core move of this practice; one stack with its views shows it.
